description:
The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award is a prestigious recognition conferred by the Government of Odisha, India. 

It was established in the year 1993. 

The award is named after Biju Patnaik, a prominent leader and former Chief Minister of Odisha. 

Biju Patnaik is celebrated for his contributions to the state and his role in Indian politics. 

The primary objective of the Biju Patnaik Bravery Award is to honor and recognize acts of bravery and courage among the youth of Odisha. 

The award aims to inspire young individuals to demonstrate valor and selflessness in the face of adversity. 

It seeks to promote a culture of bravery and heroism among the youth. 

The award is presented annually on the occasion of the Utkal Divas, which is celebrated on April 1st every year. 

The award is given to individuals who have exhibited exceptional courage in saving lives or in performing acts of bravery. 

The award is not limited to any specific age group but primarily focuses on young individuals. 

Candidates for the award are typically between the ages of 8 and 18 years. 

The award consists of a cash prize and a certificate of merit. 

The cash prize awarded is INR 50,000. 

The recipients also receive a medal that symbolizes their bravery. 

The award is intended to encourage and motivate others to act courageously. 

The eligibility criteria for the Biju Patnaik Bravery Award include being a resident of Odisha. 

Candidates must have performed an act of bravery that involves saving lives or helping others in distress. 

The act of bravery must have occurred within the last year preceding the award. 

Applications for the award can be submitted by individuals or through recommendations from local authorities. 

The application process requires the submission of a detailed account of the act of bravery. 

Documents required include identity proof and any media reports or certificates that validate the act. 

Applications can be submitted to the Department of Home Affairs, Government of Odisha. 

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set for January 31st each year. 

The selection process involves a thorough review of the applications by a committee constituted by the government. 

The committee evaluates the acts of bravery based on their impact and significance. 

Once the selection is made, the awardees are notified in February. 

The award ceremony takes place on April 1st during the Utkal Divas celebrations. 

The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award has recognized numerous young heroes since its inception. 

The award has been instrumental in highlighting the importance of courage and selflessness in society. 

It has also served to inspire many young people to engage in acts of bravery. 

The award is widely publicized through various media channels. 

This helps in raising awareness about the acts of bravery performed by the youth. 

The Government of Odisha actively promotes the award to encourage more nominations. 

The award has a significant impact on the community by fostering a sense of pride and responsibility. 

Many awardees have gone on to become role models in their communities. 

The award has also received recognition from various organizations and institutions. 

It has been acknowledged for its role in promoting bravery among the youth. 

The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award is part of a broader initiative by the Government of Odisha to encourage positive values. 

This initiative includes various other awards and recognitions for different fields. 

The award serves as a reminder of the importance of courage in everyday life. 

It emphasizes that bravery can take many forms, from saving lives to standing up for what is right. 

The award has been a source of motivation for many young individuals in Odisha. 

It encourages them to be vigilant and proactive in their communities. 

The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award is a testament to the legacy of Biju Patnaik. 

His vision for a brave and resilient society continues to inspire generations. 

The award not only recognizes bravery but also promotes the values of compassion and service. 

The Government of Odisha remains committed to honoring the bravery of its youth. 

This commitment is reflected in the continued support and promotion of the award. 

The award has become an integral part of the cultural fabric of Odisha. 

It highlights the significance of youth engagement in community service and bravery. 

The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award is a shining example of how recognition can inspire positive change. 

It serves as a platform for young heroes to share their stories and inspire others. 

The award has also led to increased community involvement in recognizing local heroes. 

Local schools and organizations often participate in the nomination process. 

This fosters a sense of community pride and collective responsibility. 

The impact of the Biju Patnaik Bravery Award extends beyond the individual recipients. 

It encourages a culture of bravery and selflessness in society as a whole. 

The award continues to evolve with changing societal needs and values. 

The Government of Odisha regularly reviews the award process to ensure it remains relevant. 

The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award is a significant initiative in promoting youth empowerment. 

It recognizes the potential of young individuals to make a difference in their communities. 

The award is a celebration of courage that resonates with the spirit of Odisha. 

The legacy of Biju Patnaik lives on through the bravery of the youth he inspired. 

The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award is not just an award but a movement towards a braver society.
